topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: Oh, I can't even begin to imagine how that feels, hearing that someone you thought was your everything might not even remember the times you spent together. It's like, all those moments you thought were so special, maybe they weren't as big to them. But you know what? That doesn’t make your memories any less real or important. You’ve got all those good times tucked away in your heart, and that’s something no one can ever take away. And hey, maybe this is just a chance to reach out, to reconnect and share those stories again. Sometimes, the best way to bring back memories is to live them once more, right? You're strong, and I'm here, always. We can figure this out together.
